title: The Wedding Reception and the Two Gunshots
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Ran, Sonoko, Megure, Takagi, Chiba) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved (person/location/object). The old cases/ file's culprit (s1 Yoshifumi Ito) was correct, but its event description had the deception backwards: e2's desc says Ito timed the killings 'so it appears Masaru died after Miho,' when the transcript establishes the opposite -- inheritance law (stated on-screen: Masaru's fortune passes to Miho only if he dies BEFORE her, and then to her own family when she dies after him) meant Ito needed it to look like Masaru died FIRST and Miho SECOND, even though he actually killed Miho first and faked a second gunshot (the suzume-odoshi/bird-scarer) to make it look like Miho died later. This reversed-clue error is corrected here. The old file also romanized the uncle as 'Shiro Hatakeyama'; the transcript's character card gives 'Kenshiro Hatakeyama,' used here. The old file omitted several named reception guests (Yuuko Hatakeyama, Kenshiro Hatakeyama) and the mutual Arisa/Rikako red-herring accusations, both restored here. Two unnamed background characters (the villa's farmer-caretaker who explains local monkey-scarer devices, and the hotel employee/lamp-repairman who witnessed someone leaving Miho's cottage) are not given person nodes since they are never named in the transcript; the repairman's sighting is captured as clue c1 instead. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: A lamp repairman saw someone leaving Miho's cottage around 9:45pm, about 30 minutes before Masaru's body was found -- proving Miho died first, the opposite of the assumed order.
Surveillance footage shows no one ever approached the flower bed, yet the gun turned up there -- it must have been thrown in from across the river, not placed by hand.
Only Yoshifumi's debt is resolved by Masaru dying before Miho -- no other suspect gains anything from that specific death order.
